pages.text: You've heard that in the age of legends, skeletons once bore the noses of villagers. You suspect this is merely a tall tale spread by villagers themselves. But for a legendary necromancer like yourself, reanimating the skeletons of villagers to fight for you is a trivial task.
Old-timer, you're not dead... you're still alive...

pages.title: Skeleton Villager Servants
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Gravestone is located in a village $(br)$(l)OR$()$() $(li)14 Dirt Paths
